channel.title: PayoutFolio — Financial & Technical Ledger
channel.description: Country-Aware Freelancer Payout Engine, Browser CSV Auditor & 30 Client-Side Calculators

item.title: Cross-Border Freelancer Payout, Reverse Invoice & Tax Comparison Engine
item.description: Compare end-to-end net take-home pay and required reverse invoice amounts across Upwork, Direct Contracts, Fiverr, Payoneer, Wise, and SWIFT for Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Philippines, and India.

item.title: Private Browser CSV Transaction & Hidden FX Fee Auditor
item.description: Check a standardized four-column transaction CSV against illustrative provider baselines, entirely in your browser. Raw provider exports need conversion first.

item.title: Payoneer Fee & Net Payout Calculator
item.description: Model Payoneer receiving fees, local bank withdrawal deductions, and FX conversion markup.

item.title: Wise International Transfer & FX Calculator
item.description: Estimate Wise (TransferWise) variable transfer percentage, fixed wire cost, and net recipient amount.

item.title: Lemon Squeezy Merchant of Record Fee Calculator
item.description: Calculate Lemon Squeezy 5% + $0.50 base MoR fees, international card surcharges, and payout transfer costs.

item.title: Gumroad 10% + Processing Fee Calculator
item.description: Calculate Gumroad's 10% flat commission plus credit card processing fees and your net creator take-home pay.

item.title: Paddle SaaS Checkout & MoR Fee Calculator
item.description: Calculate Paddle's 5% + $0.50 Merchant of Record fees and net recurring revenue for software products.

item.title: Upwork Variable Freelancer Fee Calculator (0%–15%)
item.description: Calculate Upwork's variable 0% to 15% freelancer service fee, withdrawal costs, and modeled gross bid required to reach your target net pay.

item.title: Fiverr 20% Seller Commission & Payout Calculator
item.description: Calculate Fiverr's 20% seller commission and required order price to reach your target freelance earnings.

item.title: Stripe Card, International & FX Fee Calculator
item.description: Calculate Stripe 2.9% + $0.30 domestic card fees plus +1.5% international card and +1% currency conversion fees.

item.title: PayPal Commercial & International Fee Calculator
item.description: Calculate PayPal Goods & Services fees (3.49% + $0.49), cross-border surcharges (+1.5%), and FX spread.

item.title: Armenia Freelancer, Sole Proprietor & Gross Turnover Tax Calculator (Art. 257)
item.description: Model an Armenian dram turnover scenario using editable percentage and fixed reserves. Tax eligibility, thresholds and social contributions are not determined automatically.

item.title: SaaS Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) & Churn Calculator
item.description: Calculate SaaS Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), LTV:CAC ratio, and annual revenue lost to monthly churn.

item.title: Break-Even ROAS & Target CPA Ad Calculator
item.description: Calculate your exact Break-Even Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) and maximum profitable Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).

item.title: Website Display Ad & Game eCPM Revenue Calculator
item.description: Estimate monthly website or HTML5 game ad earnings from daily sessions, ad impressions per visit, eCPM, and platform revenue split.

item.title: E-Commerce & Dropshipping Net Margin Calculator
item.description: Calculate net profit per order and profit margin percentage after product cost, shipping, ad CPA, and gateway fees.

item.title: Email Campaign Contribution Calculator
item.description: Estimate conversions and contribution before campaign costs from subscribers, click-through rate, conversion rate and contribution per sale.

item.title: Conversion Rate Lift & Monthly Revenue Impact Calculator
item.description: Calculate how much additional monthly and annual revenue a small conversion rate improvement generates.

item.title: JSON to TypeScript Interface & Zod Schema Converter
item.description: Convert any raw JSON object or API payload into strict TypeScript interfaces and runtime Zod validation schemas instantly in your browser.

item.title: Cron Expression Explainer & Schedule Validator
item.description: Validate numeric five-field cron syntax and describe each field. Execution dates and named months/weekdays are not supported.

item.title: Offline JWT Token Header & Payload Decoder
item.description: Inspect JSON Web Token (JWT) headers, claims, and expiration timestamps 100% client-side without exposing secrets over the network.

item.title: SQL Query Pretty Printer & Clause Formatter
item.description: Format minified or messy SQL queries with clean uppercase keywords and structured clause indentation.

item.title: UTF-8 Safe Base64 & URL Encoder / Decoder
item.description: Encode UTF-8 text to Base64, Base64Url and URL encoding, or select a decoding operation.

item.title: Instant Browser CSV to JSON & SQL Converter
item.description: Convert CSV spreadsheet rows with headers into formatted JSON arrays locally in your browser.

item.title: Email & Invoice Reference Finder
item.description: Extract email-like strings and #INV-123 style invoice references from text using the documented built-in pattern.

item.title: SVG to CSS Data URI & React JSX Component Converter
item.description: URL-encode SVG markup for a CSS data URI and apply basic class/stroke-width JSX attribute substitutions. Review complex SVG manually.

item.title: Freelance Target Annual Income to Billable Hourly Rate Calculator
item.description: Calculate your minimum billable hourly and daily rate after accounting for vacation days, non-billable admin time, overhead, and taxes.

item.title: PERT 3-Point Software Project Time & Quote Calculator
item.description: Use the engineering PERT formula (Optimistic, Most Likely, Pessimistic hours) to calculate realistic project timelines and fixed-price quotes.

item.title: AI LLM API Token & Monthly Cost Calculator
item.description: Estimate a 30-day token budget using total tokens per request, a manually blended price per million tokens, and a blended effective discount.

item.title: Cryptographic Password & Entropy Bits Generator
item.description: Generate high-entropy random API keys and passwords using `window.crypto.getRandomValues()` and calculate brute-force entropy bits.

item.title: Basic Markdown to HTML Snippet Converter
item.description: Convert basic headings, bold text and simple list items to an HTML snippet. Full Markdown parsing and HTML sanitization are not provided.

item.title: UTM Marketing URL Builder & Campaign Tag Generator
item.description: Generate properly URL-encoded UTM tracking links (`utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`) for analytics attribution.
